collective-collective:ashbyhq:72b49fac-c.title: Senior/Staff Security Engineer
collective-collective:ashbyhq:72b49fac-c.description: About Collective: Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork. Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary), QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft. About the role: We're hiring a Senior/Staff Product Security Engineer to build the security-critical systems at the heart of Collective's member platform. This is a software engineering role first: you'll design and ship the code that governs how our platform authenticates users and services, what they're authorized to do, and how our members' data is protected. You'll own the authentication and authorization architecture end to end — not as a reviewer or advisor, but as the engineer whose commits land in production. You'll set the direction of this work, not just execute it: what gets built and in what order. As Collective expands its use of AI and agent-based workflows, you'll build the patterns those systems use to authenticate and operate safely. You'll sit on the Security team and spend your days in the product codebase, working alongside product engineers. What you'll do: - Own the end-to-end authentication and authorization architecture of Collective's member platform — session management, multi-factor authentication, authorization enforcement, and machine-to-machine authentication — and personally design, write, and ship the changes that improve it. - Extend those patterns to delegated and agent-based access: how AI agents and third parties act on a member's behalf with scoped, time-boxed, revocable authority — and how their actions are attributed and audited. - Drive the programmatic protection of sensitive member data: design and implement application-layer encryption for member documents and data — key management, envelope encryption, rotation — and build the controls that protect sensitive data in code (scoped access, tokenization, redaction in logs and pipelines) rather than in policy. - Lead the design process for the systems you own: write RFCs, run design reviews, and bring product engineers along on security-critical changes. - Threat-model the identity and data-protection systems you build, and own remediation of findings that touch your domain. - Ground encryption and access-control decisions in the regulatory requirements that apply to a platform handling sensitive member data. What you'll bring: - 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building or owning authentication, identity, authorization, or data-protection systems in production. - Strong backend engineering skills — you're fluent shipping production code in a modern web stack (we run Python/Django on AWS), and you're comfortable making substantial changes to a codebase other teams depend on. - Deep working knowledge of authentication standards and their failure modes: OAuth 2.0 (including token exchange and delegation patterns), OIDC, SAML, JWT, session management, and the differences between securing user-facing and machine-to-machine flows. - Practical applied-cryptography literacy: envelope encryption, KMS-based key management, key rotation, and the tradeoffs of encrypting data at the field, document, and storage layers. You don't need to be a cryptographer — you need to know how to use cryptography correctly in a production system. - Enough security fluency to reason about threats to the

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1cae3dac-18e5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Data) based in Spain. This is an opportunity to join a lean, autonomous engineering team building products that help organizations better understand and optimize cloud data costs. You’ll play a key role in designing and delivering new capabilities across backend systems, data engineering, visualization, and cost-management workflows. The position offers meaningful ownership, with the opportunity to shape technical direction and influence the product roadmap. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers and founding team members in a fast-moving environment where pragmatic decisions and customer impact matter. From data pipelines and transformation models to resilient application components, your work will directly improve the product experience. The role is ideal for a self-directed engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, moving quickly, and owning features from concept through release. You’ll also have the flexibility and autonomy of a distributed team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and sustainable ways of working. Design and build new product capabilities focused on data cost management, including forecasting, anomaly detection, cost allocation, and related workflows. Develop reliable and reusable backend and data-engineering solutions that surface actionable insights for customers. Build data pipelines and transformation models that support new product capabilities and identify opportunities for optimization. Create and improve data visualization features that communicate performance, query timing, efficiency, and other important metrics clearly. Develop resilient, reusable UI components that contribute to a smooth and intuitive product experience. Improve application reliability, scalability, and performance through thoughtful engineering practices and system design. Own features end to end, from identifying problems and shaping requirements through technical design, implementation, testing, and release. Evaluate technical and product tradeoffs to prioritize high-impact solutions and deliver meaningful customer value efficiently. Collaborate closely with engineers and senior stakeholders through clear proposals, documentation, code reviews, testing, and effective communication. Contribute to a culture of pragmatic execution, continuous improvement, and strong engineering quality. Requirements 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with strong expertise in backend development and data engineering. Strong working knowledge of Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, dbt, Dagster, and Snowflake . Solid understanding of system design and the ability to develop scalable, reliable technical solutions. Experience building data pipelines, transformation workflows, backend services, and data-driven product capabilities. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed environment. Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership, and remain accountable for outcomes from initial concept through delivery. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment when balancing speed, technical depth, and customer impact. Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment where priorities and requirements may change. Strong collaboration skills and a commitment to readable, maintainable code, clear documentation, and thorough testing. A proactive, curious, and positive approach to engineering, with genuine enthusiasm for solving challenging problems. Familiarity with FinOps, cloud infrastructure cost management, data-warehouse management, or observability is a plus. Previous experience working in an early-stage startup or similarly lean engineering environment is advantageous. Benefits Base salary of up to $180,000 CAD , plus additional compensation opportuni

strategicgrowthpartners-strategic-growth.title: Vice President of Pricing
strategicgrowthpartners-strategic-growth.description: Strategic Growth Partners is seeking an accomplished Vice President of Pricing to build and lead our enterprise pricing function across Federal and State, Local, and Education (SLED) government markets. This executive leadership role will directly influence corporate and client growth strategy, competitive positioning, and business development outcomes across a portfolio of strategic pursuits ranging from single-award opportunities to multi-billion-dollar GWACs and IDIQ contracts. The Vice President of Pricing will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, capture teams, and business development leaders, helping drive winning strategies on complex pursuits ranging from single-award contracts to multi-billion-dollar IDIQ and GWAC opportunities. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in federal acquisitions, labor rate estimation and transparency, Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and strategic price-to-win (PTW) methodologies to maximize contract win rates while protecting organizational profitability. This is not a traditional corporate pricing role. SGP is seeking an entrepreneurial-minded leader who wants the opportunity to build, grow, and lead a business within a business. The Vice President of Pricing will have responsibility for developing and expanding SGP’s Pricing line of business as a self-sufficient operation with its own P&L, growth objectives, client portfolio, and long-term strategy. This individual will work closely with SGP’s Business Development, Marketing, Branding, and other operating divisions to expand relationships with existing clients, generate net-new business, and build a scalable pricing organization. The role will include a growth-oriented incentive structure designed to reward the individual as the Pricing business grows and performs. SGP currently supports more than 100 clients across its portfolio of services, creating a significant built-in opportunity for cross-selling and expansion. Our clients range from small and mid-sized government contractors to large businesses and include Tribal 8(a)s, individually owned 8(a)s, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs), Woman-Owned Small Businesses (WOSBs), Small Disadvantaged Businesses (SDBs), and other organizations operating across the Federal and SLED markets. Because SGP operates through multiple specialized divisions, no single division currently supports every client, creating substantial whitespace for the right leader to leverage relationships across the enterprise, collaborate with other division leaders, expand existing accounts, and develop entirely new clients. SGP's culture is intentionally entrepreneurial and highly collaborative, with minimal corporate bureaucracy. Many of our leaders have spent significant portions of their careers within larger organizations and joined SGP because they wanted the freedom to focus on clients, execute, innovate, and grow without unnecessary corporate politics. We arelooking for a similar individual: someone who brings deep pricing expertise but also has the business-development mindset, client presence, leadership ability, and entrepreneurial drive to turn that expertise into a growing line of business. For the right person, the opportunity is significant, the platform, client base, internal capabilities, and cross-divisional relationships already exist, and the ability to grow the Pricing business is limited primarily by the leader's ambition and execution. Key Responsibilities: · Strategic Pricing & Proposal Execution · Lead the development of clear, compliant, and highly competitive cost/price proposals for Federal and SLED procurements (FPR, FFP, T&M, Cost-Plus, and IDIQ task orders). · Partner with Executive Leadership and Business Development to shape capture strategies, conduct price-to-win (PTW) modeling, and perform competitor rate benchmarking. · Build and maintain dynamic financial models, labor rate structures, indirect rate build-ups, and wrap-rate calculations.
